title: v17 verification tracker — browser-verify every user-facing change in the 17.0.0 train
body:
Tracking issue for **end-to-end browser verification of the v17 (17.0.0-rc) train**, per the release plan. A dedicated agent will work through this checklist against a running app (`PORT=3000 pnpm dev` showcase + `:5180` objectui dev server where UI-side, or the dogfood-verification flow), acting as a real admin/user. Check items off as they are verified; file a separate issue for every failure found and link it here.

> **Defect rollups:** #4482 (rc.0/rc.1 — 17 defects, all closed) · **#5145 (rc.2/rc.3 — 3 defects, 2 open)**. Individual issues are also linked from the item they block, below.

Sources of truth: the curated release page [`content/docs/releases/v17.mdx`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/content/docs/releases/v17.mdx), the 300+ pending changesets in `.changeset/`, and the objectui window `cf2d56e32a11 → 4a4829d0ef39` (incl. the backfilled range `2cb8d78e24ad...c6cfdf1288b6`, see PR #3908). The docs-sweep log lives at `docs/v17-docs-sweep.md`.

## A. Breaking behavior — verify the new posture actually enforces

- [x] **Export opt-in (#3544/#3710):** as a `member_default` user, export on any list is denied; after an admin adds `allowExport: true` to the set, export works; `viewAllRecords` alone does NOT grant export; a set carrying `allowExport` cannot bind to `everyone`/`guest` anchors; export headers still emit on an empty result (#3547); reports covered by the same axis.
- [x] **ApiMethod shrink (#3543):** an object authored with a legacy value (e.g. `apiMethods: ['upsert']`) strips to deny-all with a FROM→TO warning; primitives-declared objects still derive search/export/history correctly; Console renders the server's effective operation set (objectui#2823) and **detail/form edit & delete are gated on it** (objectui#2832), matching grid rows (objectui#2889).
- [x] **User-less flow runs refused (#3760):** a `runAs:'user'` record-change flow fired by a system write (e.g. approvals status mirror) refuses data ops with `UnscopedRunDataAccessError` naming `runAs:'system'`; the originating write still succeeds; a `runAs:'system'` flow works and is audit-attributed.
- [x] **Alias retirement (#3855):** authoring `action.execute` / `field.conditionalRequired` / `agent.knowledge.topics` is rejected with the rename in the error; `os migrate meta --from 16` rewrites all three; `agent.tools` is tombstoned (parse error, not silent strip) (#3894).
- [x] **Approval participant visibility (#3590):** a non-participant authenticated user cannot read another user's approval request (list/get/count), incl. payload snapshot, decision history, attachments; participants and admin override still can.
- [x] **Sharing (#3865/#1878):** `accessLevel:'full'` converts to `'edit'` at load; `group` recipient rejected (renamed `team`); `business_unit` recipient enforced; owner-type/`guest` rules no longer parse; the sharing-rule dialog is usable and permission-aware (objectui#2920); switching a rule off actually withdraws access (#3850).
- [x] **Membership grade closed (ADR-0108/#3723):** a value in `sys_member.role` no longer projects into `current_user.positions`; `sys_member` writes are governed (#3697); `delegated_admin` reachable in Console with narrowed pickers (objectui#2891); scoped invitations place into unit+positions (objectui#2868).
- [x] **better-auth 1.7 (rc.2):** existing password/social/SSO accounts sign in after the issuer backfill; unlink uses the account ROW id; boot log names non-derivable federated rows; 2FA obeys the operator lockout policy (#3690); SCIM provider creation works when enabled (#3653).
- [x] **Datasource fail-fast (#3741/#3758/#3826):** a bound datasource with a bad URL fails the boot with an operator-readable error; `/ready` 503s when a driver stops answering; Setup datasource list shows the real connect verdict + reason (objectui#2926); startup banner reads DSN datasources and prints no credentials (#3793). — **blocked on #4462**
- [x] **Per-tenant `unique` (#3696):** two tenants can hold the same unique value; violation message no longer leaks cross-tenant existence.
- [x] **Multi-org entitlement (ADR-0105 D12):** `group` posture refuses to activate without `@objectstack/organizations`; org switcher acts as write context with org attribution (objectui#2858).
- [x] **Node 22 floor (#3825):** dev/serve/CLI on Node 22; `EBADENGINE` warning on Node 20.

## B. Removed surfaces — verify they are actually gone (and loud)

- [x] `/graphql` → 404 (was 501); no GraphQL advertisement in discovery. — **blocked on the discovery slot question below**
- [x] SDK: `client.ai.{nlq,suggest,insights}`, `client.permissions.*`, `client.realtime.*`, `client.workflow.*`, `client.views` CRUD, notifications device/preference helpers, `projects.listTemplates()` — absent (compile error), not 404s.
- [x] CLI: `os environments create --template` rejected as unknown flag.
- [x] Console: API console lists the real AI family, tool preview links no 404 (objectui#2925/#2921); `useClientNotifications` no longer exposes device/preference delegates (objectui#2862). — **blocked on #4478 (quorum/group chips)**
- [x] Marketplace publish moved: `client.packages.install` works (`POST /packages` no longer collides, #3610); publish at `POST /packages/publish`.

## C. New capabilities — verify they work end-to-end

- [x] **Files as records (ADR-0104):** upload against a field with `accept`/`maxSize` → violations rejected server-side (`FileConstraintError`, direct API call too, not just the widget); stored value is a `sys_file` id, read expands; downloads carry real filename+content-type (#3504); governed download denies an unauthorized caller; `os migrate files-to-references` dry-run reports / `--apply` converts+verifies; strict mode only after the flag; Console adopts the reference shape incl. localized upload widget (objectui#2828/#2819); image fields render consistently with click-to-zoom (objectui#2837).
- [x] **Dynamic approver routing (#3447):** `expression` approvers resolve at node entry over `current`/`trigger`/`vars` (bare `record` rejected with prescriptive error); `resolveAs` + `per_group` sign-off; `onEmptyApprovers` all three policies (incl. `auto_approve` continuing the approve edge); decision outputs: declared keys accepted → resume as `<nodeId>.<key>` vars, undeclared rejected, typed outputs render record pickers (objectui#2831/#2827); live `field`/`manager` resolution lets an earlier step route a later one.
- [x] **Approvals UX:** quorum progress, per-group chips (objectui#2811), admin override for unstaffed approver (#3424, objectui#2810), timeline attachment chip opens (objectui#2821), `lockRecord` honored — "in approval (editable)" vs locked (objectui#2906/#2914), decision recorded against the authenticated caller (#3800), status mirror names the human (#3783), dead run leaves no RECORD_LOCKED (#3456). — **blocked on #4478 / #4466**
- [x] **Write observability:** PATCH/POST `/data` returns `droppedFields` (single, bulk, cross-object batch #3794); Console toasts on silently-dropped read-only fields (objectui#2814) and keeps warnings on detail (objectui#2914); flow step warnings in Runs panel (#3407).
- [x] **`record-after-write` trigger (#3427):** fires on create OR update with `previous` null on create; Studio offers the new trigger and hides never-firing `record-change`.
- [x] **Screen flows (#3528):** pause → Console completes it; `visibleWhen` honored in render+validation; runner doesn't tear down its host. — **blocked on #4477**
- [x] **Analytics:** RLS/tenant scope on ObjectQL path (#3597), `dateRange` applied (#3650), effective granularity in labels+drills (#3588), FK-expand cross-object grouping / fail-closed (#3654), label lookups RLS-scoped (#3602), widget `dateGranularity`/`sortBy`/`limit` honored (objectui#2864), funnel stage order, `{current_user_id}` in widget filters (objectui#2857). — **blocked on #4467**
- [x] **Historical import (#3479/#3493/#3549):** wizard "Import as historical data" (objectui#2815) skips state machine + preserves audit timeline, undo included; row errors human-readable, no raw SQL (#3566); email format validated in preview (objectui#2840).
- [x] **i18n:** `/i18n/labels` emits declared shape with help/options (#3847); product-authored translations render (#3778); all ten Console packs at key parity (objectui#2909); system-settings hub localized (objectui#2859); SSO/SCIM/user-position/import-job admin objects translated.
- [x] **Seeds:** boot banner `Seeds: X inserted · Y updated · Z skipped` + yellow REJECTED line (#3415/#3430); marketplace rehydrate heals sample data.
- [x] **Grid/detail:** eleven summary aggregations (objectui#2890), real match total under server pagination (objectui#2873), Kanban Uncategorized lane (objectui#2804), `$or` filters AND their contents (driver-sql), datetime grouping not collapsing to `(null)` on SQLite (#3773), empty group bucket is real `null` (#3839).

## D. Docs verification (site)

- [x] `/docs/releases` reachable from the **left sidebar** (restored in #3908) and `/docs/releases/v17` renders with Console section + upgrade checklist.
- [x] Re-run the docs sweep per `docs/v17-docs-sweep.md` (watermark: `a641d10` · 305 changesets · objectui `4a4829d0ef39`) — v17 is still iterating; append run 2+ to the log.

## E. Known out-of-scope items already logged

- Spec comment drift: `core-services.zod.ts` `'ai'` member comment still says "NLQ, Chat, Suggest, Insights" (comment-only, spec-touching PR).
- `content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx` predates the v17 window; needs its own regeneration pass.
- RC exit: after `changeset pre exit`, re-check the v17 page's version wording and this checklist's remaining items.


---

## F. 17.0.0-rc.1 supplement

Sections A–E were written against the **rc.0** cut (watermark `a641d10`, just after the rc.0 version commit `fc156fa4a`). This section adds what shipped in **17.0.0-rc.1** (version commit `2bafe62e8`, 2026-07-31): the window **`a641d10` → `2bafe62e8`**, ~340 non-release commits, objectui pin advanced `4a4829d0ef39 → e651c936870e → a136322f8723 → bebaebd39ace → 7d9734d5e321`. (Commits after `2bafe62e8` — #4421/#4423/#4424/#4425/#4427/#4429 — are post-rc.1 and belong to the next rc's checklist.) Same rules: check off what passes, file a separate issue per failure and link it here.

### F1. Actions — identity, dispatch, and failure semantics (ADR-0110 / ADR-0112)

- [x] **Undeclared executables refused (#3958/#3987):** invoking an action name the object never declared is refused; the `OS_ALLOW_UNDECLARED_ACTIONS` opt-out no longer exists; action identity is `name` (Console carries the D1 fix, objectui `a136322f8723`).
- [x] **Dispatch honors the declared type (#3919/#3930/#3934):** a `flow` action runs its flow (params seeded with the row id), a `script` action runs its body over REST; a global (object-less) action is reachable at its real key (`/actions//:action`, #4005) — showcase ships a global-action specimen and a bulk selected-records action (#4201).
- [x] **Failures speak HTTP (#3969/#3951/#3920):** a rejected action → 400 with the declared envelope; a CRASHED action → 500, never a 200 with `success:false`; `VALIDATION_FAILED` → 400 with `fields[]`, and a form action anchors those field errors on the form controls across the sandbox boundary (#3937). — **blocked on #4431**
- [x] **Error vocabulary is one catalog (ADR-0112, #3988/#4021/#3971):** `error.code` is SCREAMING_SNAKE semantic string, HTTP status lives in `httpStatus`; field-validation messages are localized and name the field by its **label** (#4014); no raw Zod shapes leak onto the wire (#4035).
- [x] **Action params enforced by default (#4213):** an out-of-contract param is refused with no opt-in flag; an action body writing `ctx.record` where it cannot land is visible at call time (#4357).

### F2. Sharing & security hardening (ADR-0111)

- [x] **Share management has an authorization layer (#3965):** a user who merely *sees* a record cannot manage its shares; a record's share-manager can revoke share-links on it (#3986); hierarchy managers manage shares only within their write DEPTH (#3997).
- [x] **Verb boundary (#3975):** an `edit`-level share does NOT grant delete.
- [x] **Fail-closed rules:** a sharing rule with no criteria shares **nothing** (#3929); `criteria_json` is declaratively required (#4044); a **disabled** RLS policy no longer grants (#3980). — **blocked on #4433 / #4434**
- [x] **Anonymous access is always denied for data (#4043):** the `api.requireAuth` opt-out is gone; `audience:'public'` still publishes a book anonymously on a secure-by-default deployment (#3995); with no auth implementation the `/auth` domain answers 501 instead of fabricating a login (#4179); dev security stubs refuse to load under `NODE_ENV=production` (#4126).

### F3. Query/write strictness — silent drops became refusals

- [x] **List/query params:** unknown list query params are rejected, not read as zero-matching filters (#4169); `sort`/`select`/`expand` naming a missing field are rejected (#4240); a dotted-path sort is refused (#4303); `searchFields`/`groupBy`/`aggregations` naming a missing field are rejected (#4315); a filter the server cannot apply is rejected (#4209), and an uncompilable filter throws instead of matching everything (#4029).
- [x] **Filter semantics:** implicit field filters AND-merge with an explicit `filter` instead of being dropped (#4190); a `$filter` array that is not a filter AST is rejected (#4200).
- [x] **Writes:** bulk writes bind to the object in the **path**, not the body (#3933); `deleteMany` selects on the id list only (#3897); the batch-size cap is enforced (#3939). — **blocked on #4435**
- [x] **Paging determinism (objectui#3106, #4367/#4416):** paging a sorted grid is a partition — no duplicated/missing rows across pages; `GET /data/:object/export` honours a `search` term (#4230).

### F4. Temporal correctness (ADR-0053 D-A3/D-D)

- [x] `Field.datetime` stores one UTC form per dialect (#3953); `Field.time` stores wall-clock `HH:MM:SS` text (#4020); `Field.date` `NOW()` default reads the **UTC** calendar day (#4026).
- [x] A bare-day upper bound (`<= 2026-07-31`) covers the **whole** day on SQL, memory and mongo drivers (#4041/#4048), and the RLS write-side `check` evaluator honours the same calendar-day bounds (#4076).
- [x] `os migrate plan` lists the datetime storage convergence for a pre-v17 datastore (#3964).

### F5. Analytics honesty

- [x] Empty analytics slot **404s** — the degraded shim serving unscoped aggregates is retired (#3989); `/analytics` mounts only when the capability exists (#4019); request bodies are validated at entry (#4010). — **blocked on #4467 / #4437**
- [x] A measure emits its **declared** aggregate, not COUNT(*) (#4184/#4153); `$or`/`$not` filters reach the query (#4175); the time axis is ordered by default and `report.order` is live (#3921/#3938); a `timeDimensions` bucket projects into result rows (#4069).

### F6. New capabilities since the rc.0 cut

- [x] **Multi-value lookup seeds (#3911):** a seed row with a natural-key **array** on a `multiple:true` lookup resolves to references (showcase specimen); dropped reference fields are counted in the boot banner (#3932).
- [x] **ADR-0113 required split (#4031):** `required` enforces on **write** (yields `fields[]`), `storage.notNull` is the column constraint; the contradictory uniqueness double-declaration lints (#4034).
- [x] **Approvals:** `decisionOutputs` may be declared required (objectui#2955); structured reassign hand-off (#4365) and flow **system-write audit attribution** (#4366) via #4403; per-run flow summaries `selected / acted / skipped` in Runs (#4377), with an honest marker when `acted` is incomplete (#4397).
- [x] **UI metadata:** `FormSection.pane` split-pane placement renders (#4160); `element:button` declares its action via InlineActionSchema (objectui#2997, #4135); legacy string `rowActions` still render (objectui#2960, #4101).
- [x] **Files (ADR-0104 D3 wave 2):** released-field-file collection runs behind the per-deployment migration gate (#4208), proven end-to-end on a real boot (#4285).

### F7. Boot / CLI / authoring strictness

- [x] `os serve` boots the platform with **no compiled artifact** (#4110); a config-booted app keeps its module code so action handlers reach the engine (#4129, regression from #3887); the boot merge keeps the authored `api` block (#4008); boot-quiet window buffers plugin logs instead of discarding them (#4084).
- [x] `os migrate value-shapes` gates reference/structured-JSON value shapes per deployment (#4235); migrate DDL is deferred until confirmed and SQLite occupancy is detected (#3924); scaffolds stamp `engines.protocol` (#4239).
- [x] **Unknown-key rejection wave (#4001 line):** authoring an unknown key on flow/permission (#4071), RLS/sharing/positions (#4099), approvals (#4119), app shell/navigation (#4165), hooks/datasources (#4207) fails validation loudly — incl. nested metadata (#4218); the nested-select object form in select lists is removed (#4268); seven dead AppSchema keys are tombstoned (#4142).
- [x] **Packaging:** every published rc tarball carries `CHANGELOG.md` (#4297) and a `files` whitelist (#4262); `plugin-hono-server` no longer serves CRUD/discovery (transport adapter only, #4296) and `registerStandardEndpoints` defaults to **false** (#4280).

### F8. Docs (run 2+)

- [x] Re-run the docs sweep per `docs/v17-docs-sweep.md` from watermark `a641d10` → `2bafe62e8`; append the run entry.
- [ ] At `changeset pre exit`: re-check the v17 release page wording and close out sections A–F.












---

## G. 17.0.0-rc.2 / rc.3 supplement

Sections A–E cover **rc.0**, F covers **rc.1**. This section covers the window **`2bafe62e8` (rc.1) → `a1a855a28`** — 277 non-release commits, 283 new changesets, objectui pin `7d9734d5e321 → f5bc4c78be76`. Two release cuts fall inside it: rc.2 (`89d2a4eb3`) and rc.3 (cut at `2e284b254`, published as the npm `rc` dist-tag; main has since moved 56 commits past that point, and main's `package.json` still reads `17.0.0-rc.2` because the version commit was not merged back).

All 17 defects filed from the A–F verification are **closed**; G1 re-verifies them rather than trusting the close.

Three new ADRs land in this window: **ADR-0118** (non-user actor contract), **ADR-0119** (reachable transactions + honest `atomic` batch), **ADR-0121** (declarative-endpoint routing, rules only — implementation tracked separately).

### G1. Regression — the A–F defects stay fixed

- [x] **#4467 analytics scoping.** A member with shares on 2 of 5 private notes counts 2 (not 5), and `dimensions:["title"]` returns only the titles they may read.
- [x] **#4433 / #4434 sharing-rule lifecycle.** Deactivating a rule withdraws its materialized grants; `DELETE /sharing/rules/:idOrName` succeeds on both address forms and withdraws with it.
- [x] **#4447 `created_at`.** A client-supplied `created_at` on an ordinary PATCH is dropped (and reported in `droppedFields`), not persisted.
- [x] **#4441 dangling lookups.** A `lookup` value resolving to no row is refused, including `sys_position_permission_set.permission_set_id`.
- [x] **#4462 datasource binding.** An object mapped to an unreachable datasource fails loudly rather than silently using the default store.
- [x] **#4477 screen-flow resume.** A missing required field and an undeclared key are both refused.
- [x] **#4466 approval override.** An admin override of a staffed slate is distinguishable in `sys_approval_action`.
- [x] **#4431 / #4435 / #4436 / #4437 envelopes.** Capability denial → 500; PATCH/DELETE of a missing record → 404; filter-operator refusal carries `error.code` and no driver prefix; an analytics measure naming a missing field → 400 naming the field.
- [x] **#4432 meta overlays.** Both type spellings address one namespace; an overlay never shadows the code-authored listing; DELETE removes what it addresses (see `6beb70856` — overlays now write through the SchemaRegistry). — **partially: namespace + shadowing + immediate dispatch fixed; the deleted-overlay-still-listed branch survives → #5079**
- [x] **#4455 value-shapes.** A `lookup` holding an embedded record object is reported by the scan.
- [x] **#4475 / #4478 / #4476 UI+docs.** Setup System Overview shows real counts; quorum progress and per-group chips render; the `#4286` removals are dated to 17.

### G2. ADR-0118 — the non-user actor contract

- [x] `sys_metadata_history.recorded_by` stores **NULL** for a non-user actor, not the sentinel string `'system'` (#4556); readers tolerate both on rows written before the change.
- [x] A write with no resolvable actor is **fail-closed** rather than attributed to a fabricated principal; `isSystem` is explicit at every call site that means it.
- [x] The boot banner reports the **resolved tenancy posture**, not the legacy boolean (#4801).

### G3. ADR-0119 — atomic means atomic, or it refuses

- [x] `deleteMany` / `updateMany` with `atomic: true` either run in one transaction or **refuse** — no partial application reported as success (#4620).
- [x] Batch per-row results deliver the declared `BatchOperationResultSchema` shape (#4793, hard cut); the new `ROLLED_BACK` / `NOT_ATTEMPTED` row codes appear on the rows they describe.
- [x] A bulk-write limitation is reported as the platform's, naming the constraint, instead of blaming the author (#5037). — **#5088 fixed and re-verified: `updateMany` / `deleteMany` / atomic all answer `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` for a row naming no record**

### G4. Hook / validation evaluation — the #4649 family

- [x] A hook `condition` the platform **cannot evaluate ABORTS** the operation rather than defaulting to false (#4775) — the inverse of the pre-fix behaviour.
- [x] A hook condition evaluates against the **complete** record (stored ⊕ payload), so a predicate over an unchanged field resolves (#4770).
- [x] The hook-condition CEL scope carries **`previous`**, so transition semantics are expressible and aligned with validation predicates (#4784).
- [x] An unevaluable **validation** predicate fails closed, and the merged record is total (#4649).
- [x] Parent-scoped `readonlyWhen` is enforced **server-side**, not only in the client (#4889).

### G5. Metadata plane honesty

- [x] A failed history read never invents `event_seq` / `version` (#4867, #4825).
- [x] `sys_metadata` DDL failure is loud; only "table already exists" is swallowed (#4728).
- [x] `publishDraft`'s draft-drain discriminates by cause instead of swallowing every failure (#4981).
- [x] Saved overlays are written through the SchemaRegistry and are **dispatchable immediately** (#4521) — no restart, no cache lag.
- [x] Audit history and global search sort by `order`, not `direction` (#4674).
- [x] `subscribeMetadata` delivers true `MetadataEvent`s (#4602); `subscribeData` delivers a real `DataEvent` (#4626).

### G6. Seeds / boot / driver

- [x] `Seed.env` is enforced against the runtime environment — a seed scoped to another env does not load (#4836).
- [x] The seed-loader records a counted failure as an **error**, never a warn (#4729).
- [x] The per-org tenant stamp survives seeding instead of being resolved as a natural key (#4644).
- [x] A fresh DB does not boot reported as "drifted", and `--allow-destructive` is never aimed at a framework-created index (#4884).
- [x] A fresh datastore attests on **this boot's own data**, not remembered emptiness (#4769).
- [x] An identical driver re-registration is told apart from a real name collision (#4773).
- [x] The engine resolves the `NOW()` `defaultValue` token (#4597).

### G7. Authorization surfaces

- [x] The two `session.roles` admin exemptions are gone from approvals — record lock and delegation guard (#4839).
- [x] The record lock holds for predicate (multi) updates (#4778).
- [x] Nav-item gates are enforced **inside `areas[]`**, not only on the top-level tree (#4722).
- [x] `app.areas[].visible` / `.requiredPermissions` are retired as fail-open gates (#4651) — authoring them is refused.
- [x] Permission-set projection writes only spec-recognised keys; a failed backfill is loud (#4669).
- [x] `action.body` binds only for `type: 'script'` (#4352).

### G8. The #4001 / ADR-0049 close-out wave

This window is dominated by spec surface convergence — dual-source name collapses and inert-key retirements. Most are compile-time; verify the ones with a runtime face:

- [x] Retired **datasource** keys are refused at authoring: `capabilities`, `healthCheck`, `retryPolicy`, `readReplicas` (#4583, #4468).
- [x] `connector.rateLimitConfig` and the per-provider connector template cluster are refused (#4911, #4480).
- [x] `dashboard.widgets[].responsive` is refused (#4876).
- [ ] `job` is a **code artifact** — runtime creation and org overrides are withdrawn (#4509). — **FAILS: PUT /meta still creates job and agent → #5086**
- [x] `composeStacks` no longer silently drops top-level keys: same value passes, conflict errors, undeclared warns (#5005).
- [x] `IDataDriver.findStream` and the 31 inert `DriverCapabilities` bits are gone (#4484, #4634).
- [x] `crypto.hash` is retired across all four layers (#4391).
- [x] The renamed spec exports resolve to exactly one declaration each (#4535 family: `ActionLocation`, `ConflictResolution`, `EventSchema`, `HttpMethod`, `PackageDependency`, `FieldMapping`, `RateLimitConfig`, `MetadataFormat`, `CacheStrategy`, notification vocabulary).

### G9. Client / React

- [x] The five `client-react` hooks no longer loop on dependency identity (#4693, #4694).
- [x] `@objectstack/organizations` resolves from the **host app**, and an organizations failure is classified by STAGE — import ≠ mount (#4818, cloud#1013).
- [x] The AI route's `req.user` carries the capability channel (#4705).

### G10. Docs & close-out

- [x] Docs sweep run 3: `2bafe62e8` → `a1a855a28`, adding the retired keys from G8 to the fingerprint table, plus the version-number check #4476 called for.
- [ ] At `changeset pre exit`: re-check the v17 page's version wording and close out sections A–G.
